name: Vitest
description: Unit and integration testing with Vitest in a TypeScript workspace.
architecture: Test behaviour through public interfaces, not private helpers.
structure: Tests live beside the code they exercise.
Shared fixtures live in one place.
conventions: A failing test states the expected and actual values.
testing: Cover the failure path, not only the happy path.
security: Do not commit credentials in fixtures.
documentation: Document how to run one test file and the full suite.
tooling: Coverage reporting is optional and never a target by itself.
checks: Test suite passes from a clean install

compatibility.notes: Framework-specific only; the behaviour rules above apply to any runner.
